about_body: I like the intersection where AI meets data that actually has to be correct. On the side I write about what production teaches you, and I help businesses automate work nobody should be doing by hand.
about_lede: I'm Aakash, a data engineer in Calgary. I build the unglamorous machinery companies run on — pipelines, warehouses, reconciliation jobs — and the production AI systems that sit on top of them.
contact_note: A report you hate making. A process held together by spreadsheets. An AI idea you are not sure is feasible. Start here.
hero_sub: 4+ years building production data pipelines and AI on Azure. For companies, I turn manual reporting and repetitive operations into automated systems. For myself, I write about what production teaches you.
meta_description: Aakash Patel builds production data pipelines and AI systems. For businesses: he automates reports and manual work, and puts AI to real use.

services.body: Someone on your team spends hours every week pulling data into spreadsheets, copying numbers between systems, rebuilding the same report. I build systems that do it for you: accurate, on schedule, without the Monday-morning scramble.
services.examples: Reports · spreadsheet automation · data pipelines · dashboards that update themselves
services.title: Your reports, on autopilot.

services.body: Beyond reports: assistants that answer questions from your own documents, voice agents that handle calls, AI wired into the tools you already use. Practical, tied to your business — not a demo.
services.examples: Document assistants · voice agents · AI workflow automation
services.title: AI that does real work.

services_cta: Tell me what eats your team's time. I'll tell you honestly whether it can be automated — and how.
services_note: If you run a business, you have work that should not be done by humans anymore. I find it and automate it.
